conditions.evidence: Investigating Cognitive Impairment in Obstructive Sleep Apnea
conditions.label: Obstructive Sleep Apnea

modalities.evidence: structural and resting-state functional MRI scans

output.population: Human; patients with OSA and matched healthy controls; ages 19–65; 142 participants
output.summary: Multimodal BIDS dataset on cognitive impairment in obstructive sleep apnea: nocturnal polysomnography, structural and resting-state functional MRI, cognitive assessment batteries, and questionnaires collected across evening, post-sleep, pre-nap, and post-nap sessions in patients and matched controls.
